messages.subject: KMO testing
parts:
Hi,

I have a data table of 54 columns. I have run the EFA .
fit1 <- lavaan::sem(model1, data=DSem, check.gradient = FALSE )
lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit1, standardized = TRUE)
lavaan::summary(fit1, standardized=TRUE)

kmo<-KMO(fit1)
It returned the error.
> kmo<-KMO(fit1)
Error in UseMethod("isSymmetric") :
  no applicable method for 'isSymmetric' applied to an object of class "S4"
>

Can you tell me what should be done.


The exact steps are :

===================================================
DSem <- read.table("C:\\Users\\Diya Guha Roy\\Desktop\\Articles\\Article 4\\DATA_New\\data_PZ1.txt",  header = TRUE)

model1 <- '

BE=~BE1+BE2+BE3+BE5
BA=~BA1+BA2+BA3+BA5+BA6
BAS=~BAS1+BAS2+BAS3+BAS4+BAS5+BAS6+BAS8+BAS9
PQ=~PQ1+PQ2+PQ3+PQ4+PQ5+PQ6
L=~L1+L2+L3+L4+L5+L7
INF=~INF1+INF2+INF3+INF4
C=~C1+C2+C3+C4+C5+C7+C8+C9+C10

PQC=~NA*PQ+j*C+k*PQ:C
j+k==1.8
BE=~NA*BA+a*PQC+b*BAS+c*L+d*INF
a+b+c+d==3
BE~~BE
'
fit1 <- lavaan::sem(model1, data=DSem, check.gradient = FALSE )
lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit1, standardized = TRUE)
lavaan::summary(fit1, standardized=TRUE)

kmo<-KMO(fit1)
===================================
